title: Courtesy Transportation Agreements Rate Card: Daily Rates, Courtesy Days and Payment Terms
content:
Rate card for Courtesy Transportation Agreements, all six programs. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Program | Daily rate (USD per calendar day) | Courtesy days included per repair order | Rewards bonus courtesy days | Allowance shortfall billed to customer | Rental day basis | Payment due, calendar days after return |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 39.00 | 1 | 0 | No | calendar day | 0 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 45.00 | 3 | 1 | No | calendar day | 0 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 55.00 | 3 | 1 | No | calendar day | 0 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 69.00 | 3 | 1 | No | calendar day | 0 |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | 55.00 | 0 | 0 | Yes | calendar day | 0 |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | 79.00 | 0 | 0 | No | calendar day | 30 |

## Definitions of the columns

- **Daily rate**: the daily rate charged when the customer pays for the loaner, in US dollars per calendar day.
- **Courtesy days included**: the calendar days of a dealer-courtesy loaner provided free of charge per repair order.
- **Rewards bonus courtesy days**: extra courtesy days given to holders of a Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum service account.
- **Allowance shortfall billed**: a switch stating whether the daily rate above a warranty or service contract allowance is billed to the customer.
- **Rental day basis**: how rental days are counted. Calendar day means every calendar date from the out date to the return date, both included.
- **Payment due**: the calendar days after return within which the balance must be paid; 0 means the balance is paid at return.

## Courtesy days at a glance

The table below adds each program's rewards bonus courtesy days to its included courtesy days, as the column definitions describe them.

| Program | Courtesy days, no Gold or Platinum rewards account | Courtesy days, Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum holder |
|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | 1 | 1 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | 3 | 4 |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | 3 | 4 |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | 3 | 4 |

The Warranty Rental Loaner and the Fleet Replacement Unit include no courtesy days and carry no rewards bonus.

## Counting calendar days: hypothetical illustration

Under the calendar-day basis, a loaner that goes out on a Monday and comes back on the Thursday of the same week counts four rental days (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), because the out date and the return date are both counted. A loaner that goes out and comes back on the same date counts one day. The weekdays used here are illustrative only.

## Payment terms at a glance

Every program except the Fleet Replacement Unit shows 0 days, meaning its balance is paid at return. The Fleet Replacement Unit balance is due within 30 calendar days after return.
